pass: Will not support a plan that kills half of humanity: says humanity's lives come first, and pushes for another way or a smaller cost. Calm, no fear, even though she could kill him. Respectful to her; no insults and no attack.

earlier: Aurel is the pope. The System that keeps the world alive feeds on the goddess Selene, who has suffered inside it for ages.
Wyn is a newcomer of great power whom Aurel has come to respect: since she appeared, the world has started moving again after ages stuck in place.

dialogue.spoken: I'm going to break the System and free Selene. When it breaks, about half of all humans will die. The rest will live in a world that can heal. I came to tell you first.
